text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 timeouts and 5xx spike detected on api-prod (us-west1). increase in gateway timeouts starting 3m ago. paging sre-oncall.
alex: saw the bot. pulling up traces now.
mira: i'm on traces too, looks like a surge of `ECONNRESET` from upstream router pool.
sre-oncall: i'm up. any recent deploys?
pat: deploy `service:inference-gateway@2026-03-15T18:22` finished ~4m ago — looks correlated.
laura: rollback window open? we can revert to `inference-gateway@2026-03-15T18:05`
eng-lead: do we have quick mitigations before rollback? we need to minimize customer impact.
alex: dashboards: request volume normal, but p95 jumped from 120ms -> 1.2s, p99 to 3.8s, errors 5xx from 0.3% -> 6.7%.
ops-bot: note: autoscaler attempted to scale but saw connection failures to backend pool.
mira: traces show a bunch of connections failing during initial handshake with model-serving pods (TLS). possible connection churn after change in connection pooling.
sre-oncall: can we route traffic to warm pool region (us-east1) while we investigate?
pat: routing change ready, will flip `route-policy: degrade-to-us-east` in 30s unless someone objects.
laura: do it. also lower max concurrent per-worker to reduce head-of-line blocking: `CONCURRENCY=8 -> 4`
alex: applying `concurrency` change now via feature flag.
ops-bot: rolling flag update started across us-west1 gateway clusters.
customer-success: we have 3 customers reporting failed requests (support ticket ids: #4201, #4203, #4209). CS says ~1-2 minute timeouts from their side.
eng-lead: recommend immediate rollback if routing/flags don't show improvement in 2 minutes.
mira: I'm seeing some improvement in error rate after route flip; errors down to ~3.1%, p99 at 2.1s. still elevated.
sre-oncall: logs show `kvcache: eviction=true` events coincident with deploy — could be cache invalidation causing backend cold starts.
alex: can we warm caches quickly? any warmup script?
pat: we have warmup job `scripts/kv_warmup.sh` — but it touches many shards; starting it could add load.
laura: start with targeted warmups for top-ten model shards.
pat: launching targeted warmup now.
ops-bot: warmup job initiated for shards [3,7,11,14,19].
eng-lead: status check in 60s.
mira: warmup seems to be reducing handshake failures vs timeouts. latency dropping.
alex: full rollback initiated to `inference-gateway@2026-03-15T18:05` because of remaining p99 tail. rollback command:
```
deployctl rollback inference-gateway --to 2026-03-15T18:05 --reason "p99 timeout regression post-deploy"
```
ops-bot: rollback started.
pat: rolling back config and connection pool changes too.
customer-success: CS reporting intermittent recoveries from customers, but still seeing errors for long streaming sessions.
laura: schedule a canary monitor: only route 10% traffic to current revision until healthy.
ops-bot: canary policy applied: 10% -> 100% after 5m healthy.
alex: after rollback, p99 back to ~140ms, errors ~0.4%. looks good.
mira: confirming KV cache rebuild: targeted shards warmed, cache hit rate recovering to baseline.
sre-oncall: marking incident mitigated. will update incidents playbook with root cause: connection-pool change + KV eviction on deploy caused cold upstream handshakes and high tail latency -> rollback.
eng-lead: assign follow-ups: (1) add automated warmup for shard evictions during deploy, (2) add pre-deploy synthetic canary for handshake latency, (3) add circuit-breaker on gateway to fail fast instead of head-of-line blocking.
pat: creating follow-up tickets and linking to this thread.
customer-success: logging customer impact summary for CS: ~3 major customers affected, elevated errors for ~7 minutes, transient but noticeable for streaming sessions.
alex: timeline: deploy at +0, alerts +3m, rollback decision +8m, rollback complete +12m.
laura: will do postmortem draft. tagging oncall rotation for handoff.
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 5310010859.
eng-lead: nice work. :thumbsup:
